system.description:
This spell will affect any normal or giant-sized animal, but will not affect any fantastic creature, nor one of greater than animal intelligence (2). Each victim must make a saving throw vs. spells or be paralyzed for the duration of the spell.

The druid can affect 1 Hit Die of animals for each level of experience, ignoring "pluses" to Hit Dice. For example, a 20th level druid could cast the spell at 10 giant toads (which have 2+2 Hit Dice each). Note that the spell can affect summoned, conjured, or controlled animals.
